title: The Greek Drinking Party
hook: Ancient Greek drinking parties had one strict rule: NEVER drink wine straight.

claimsToVerify: Symposiums were strictly controlled by a master of ceremonies.
Greeks generally watered down their wine.
Kottabos was a game played at symposia by flicking wine dregs.
Symposia sometimes ended with a komos or street parade.
